facts.fact: The Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services reports that in 2019/20 it pursued its legislative programme in line with the National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper, and developed a framing document for the White Paper's review.
facts.system: National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper

facts.fact: The Department's Programme 3, ICT Policy Research and Capacity Development, is the unit that develops ICT policy and legislation for the sector, with an ICT Policy Development sub-programme and a Research sub-programme tasked with delivering a national ICT strategy.
facts.system: National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper

facts.fact: The annual report records, against the indicator 'ICT legislation and policies in line with the White Paper', that the Digital Development Fund Bill, the Data and Cloud Policy and the framing document for the White Paper's review were developed in 2019/20; it reports no progress against the White Paper's own targets.
